entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Balcony_Intro_1
entries.dialogueText: The grand double doors of the Palas Rezna balcony swung open to the roar of over forty thousand citizens packed shoulder to shoulder in the Royal Plaza. Banners of House Toras, Azaro, and Sazon fluttered in the sea breeze. Below, brass microphones were wired to radio broadcasting trucks transmitting your voice to every household across Rizia.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Balcony_Whisper
entries.dialogueText: Hugo leaned in, his voice barely audible beneath the roar of the crowd. "The whole kingdom listens, Romus. Give them words worthy of a king."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Doctrine_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: You stepped forward to the stone balustrade, raising your sovereign hand. A profound hush fell over the ocean of citizens.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Revanchist
entries.dialogueText: Sons and daughters of Rizia! For over twenty-five years, our kingdom has borne the sting of separation in silence. But House Toras does not bow to tyrants! Today, the Royal Army marches to reclaim our sovereign soil and restore the royal dignity of our kingdom!
entries.menuText: "Sons and daughters of Rizia! We march to reclaim what was stolen and restore the honor of our ancestors!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Revanchist_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: A thunderous roar erupted from the crowd, bayonets flashing in the sun as royal guards raised their rifles in salute. Patriotic cheers echoed down the avenues of Porte Drazon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Liberation
entries.dialogueText: People of Rizia! We march not out of hatred, but out of sacred love for our brothers and sisters in Zille who have endured Smolak's secret police and broken promises. We go to bring them home to their true kingdom!
entries.menuText: "We come not as conquerors, but as liberators to free our brothers and sisters from Smolak's tyranny!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Liberation_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: Tears flowed freely among the elder citizens in the crowd, and chants of 'Long live King Romus!' resonated throughout the ancient plaza.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Legalist
entries.dialogueText: Citizens of Rizia and observers across Merkopa. Rizia is a realm of honor and constitutional order. The 1927 lease has expired. In reclaiming Zille, we enforce the sacred rule of law that Wiktor Smolak has trampled underfoot!
entries.menuText: "The 1927 agreement has expired. We uphold international law where Wehlen has trampled it!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Legalist_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: Foreign correspondents frantically scribbled notes, while the crowd applauded with deep, dignified respect for the Crown's measured authority.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Balcony_Whisper
entries.dialogueText: Laurento inclined his head beside you as the roar of the crowd swelled. "Both the realm and the ambassadors in Kyrute are listening, Your Majesty."
